column2: Doctors use ultrasound to take pictures of a baby inside its mother, using sound waves too high for us to hear.
column3: 醫生利用超音波替母親腹中的寶寶拍照，那是人耳聽不到的高頻聲波。
column5: ultra 超越 + sound 聲音：超過人耳能聽的聲音
column8: 超音波；超過人耳聽覺頻率

column2: Over millions of years, sedimentation buried the ancient seabed under thick layers of mud and sand.
column3: 經過數百萬年，沉積作用把古老的海床埋在厚厚的泥沙層底下。
column5: sediment 沉積物 + -ation：泥沙慢慢沉下去堆起來

column2: Bathymetry helps scientists draw maps of mountains and valleys hidden beneath the ocean surface.
column3: 水深測量術幫助科學家繪製藏在海面下的山脈與山谷地圖。
column5: bathy 深 + metry 測量：量海有多深
column8: 水深測量術、海底地形學

column2: The lithosphere, made of the crust and upper mantle, is broken into large moving plates.
column3: 由地殼和上部地函組成的岩石圈，分裂成許多會移動的大板塊。
column5: litho 石頭 + sphere 球層：包住地球的石頭殼

column2: Hydrology is the study of how rain flows into rivers, soaks into soil, and returns to the sea.
column3: 水文學是研究雨水如何流入河川、滲入土壤，再回到海洋的學問。
column5: hydro 水 + -logy 學問：研究水的學問
column8: 水文學、地球水循環研究

column2: Paleoclimatology uses ice cores and tree rings to rebuild what the climate was like thousands of years ago.
column3: 古氣候學利用冰芯與樹木年輪，重建數千年前的氣候是什麼樣子。
column5: paleo 古老 + climate 氣候 + -logy 學問：古代氣候學
column7: pa - le - o - cli - ma - tol - o - gy
column8: 古氣候學、古代氣候重建

column2: The biosphere includes every place on Earth where living things can survive, from deep oceans to high mountains.
column3: 生物圈包含地球上生物能夠生存的每個地方，從深海到高山都算在內。
column5: bio 生命 + sphere 球層：所有生命住的那一圈
column8: 生物圈、生命活動總區域

column2: Chlorosis makes the leaves of a plant turn pale yellow because they lack enough chlorophyll.
column3: 缺綠病使植物的葉子因缺乏足夠的葉綠素而變成淡黃色。
column5: chloro 綠色：綠色(chlorophyll)不夠，葉子就變黃
column8: 植物缺綠病、葉片黃化症
